items.title: Alvin Queen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 23, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Tommy’s got some very tricky beginnings and endings so you’ve got to really watch out.

ctx.x: I know Junior’s whole repertoire. As a matter of fact I produced two albums on Junior’s name for my label for the record company. So me and Junior is like, I spoke to Junior the other day, and we did three tours of Japan together. Junior — you have to be special to work with Junior. Junior has a — all of them man have something — Ray Bryant, Junior Mance, Tommy Flanagan — they all have their own way of playing, their own way. And then that’s why at rehearsals you’re like that because you’re trying to see how can…
mind?” I mean I did a TV show with a double CD set, I never knew where I was going, “Live in Japan.”
